system.description:
Flickering flames flare out from the caster’s fingertips and scorch his enemies. Damaging effect: Power = ½ Will +3, VA 2. Die of Fate to determine IMS. Weapon Length: as Spear; Range: as Pistol.

Obstacle: 3^. Actions: 1.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Presence | Element: Fire | Impetus: Destroy | Duration: Instantaneous | Resource Points: 12

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 212
